findings.title: Miasma Supply-Chain Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories Across Azure / Azure-Samples / Microsoft / MicrosoftDocs Plus AI Coding Environments (Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Cursor / VS Code) — Major Scope Expansion from npm Registry
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft GitHub organizations (Azure, Azure-Samples, Microsoft, MicrosoftDocs); 73 repositories disabled by GitHub; durabletask PyPI / .NET / Go / Java / JavaScript / MSSQL ecosystem; AI coding environments (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code); same actor as TeamPCP May 2026 wave
findings.summary: Miasma worm (Watchtower 2026-06-02 NEWS / 2026-06-03 UPDATE) compromised 73 repos across four official Microsoft GitHub orgs and now propagates via a 4.3 MB payload auto-executed inside Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Cursor / VS Code AI coding environments; credentials assessed as never fully lost from May TeamPCP wave.

findings.title: depthfirst AI Agent Discloses 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg — CVE-2026-39210 → CVE-2026-39218 Heap / Stack Overflows in TS Demuxer Through VP9 Decoder, Patched Upstream
findings.affected_technology: FFmpeg C codebase (~1.5M LOC); parsers and demuxers across TS through VP9; deployment footprint spans media transcoders, Python wheels, container images, NVR appliances, video-conferencing back ends, CDN ingest layers; some bugs latent 15-20 years (one from 2003)
findings.summary: depthfirst's autonomous AI agent identified 21 zero-day heap / stack overflows in FFmpeg parsers and demuxers for ~$1,000 in compute (THN 2026-06-06); 9 CVE-2026-3921X assignments plus un-numbered fixes patched upstream, per-bug PoC inputs published, no in-wild yet but broad media-pipeline footprint warrants prompt patch.

findings.title: Bright Data Residential-Proxy SDK in Free Smart-TV and Mobile Apps Repurposes 400M Consumer IPs for AI-Scraper Anti-Bot Bypass — Bypasses iOS VPN, "Weaker Than Most Malware"
findings.affected_technology: Bright Data (formerly Luminati) residential-proxy SDK; embedded in free smart-TV apps (PlayWorks Digital, CloudTV, Longvision partners) plus iOS and Android consumer apps; ~400M residential IPs, 200 GB/month per device default; traffic bypasses iOS VPN profiles; consumer device population on corporate networks (conference-room / lobby / executive smart TVs, BYOD iOS)
findings.summary: Include Security + Buchodi disclosed 2026-06-06 that free smart-TV and mobile apps embedding Bright Data's SDK silently convert consumer devices into residential exit nodes for a 400M-IP commercial proxy network used by AI scrapers to evade anti-bot defenses; controls weaker than most malware and traffic bypasses iOS VPN.

noted.product: OpenAI ChatGPT Lockdown Mode defensive feature launch (THN 2026-06-06)
noted.summary: Optional advanced setting disables live browsing, image retrieval, deep research, agent mode, canvas networking, and file downloads to reduce prompt-injection / data-exfiltration blast radius; OpenAI acknowledges residual risk via enabled Apps and unforeseen capability combinations — defensive AI-platform hardening calibration data point.

noted.product: Project Zero discloses 4 bugs in FreeType (oss-security 2026-06-06)
noted.summary: Google Project Zero published four FreeType font-rendering library vulnerabilities; client-side / font-rendering scope reachable via document and PDF handlers; flag for endpoint-fleet patch cadence and PDF-processing-server fleets bundling FreeType.

HPACK-amplification + flow-control-stalling HTTP/2 Bomb pattern (Watchtower 2026-06-04 HIGH covering Apache CVE-2026-49975 / NGINX / IIS / Envoy / Pingora) confirmed in Perl Protocol::HTTP2; limited Perl-HTTP/2 production deployment, mod_perl + Mojolicious shops should patch.

noted.product: OpenStack Ironic DoS under reduced process stack size (OSSN-0099, oss-security 2026-06-06)
noted.summary: DoS triggered in OpenStack Ironic when operating under constrained stack conditions; limited deployment footprint to OpenStack-Ironic-running private clouds; calibration only.

noted.product: Perl DBI < 1.648 heap overflow on SQL statement parsing (oss-security 2026-06-06)
noted.summary: Perl database-interface library memory overflow on SQL statement parsing; legacy-Perl scope, calibration only.
Metric-injection issues in the DataDog statistics Perl library covering both base parsing and event-tag handling; observability-stack pollution risk, low blast radius.

noted.summary: Industry-survey calibration data point on enterprise AI security-tooling adoption; not an advisory.
